sample_id.description: Unique identifier or name you choose for this environmental sample within your lab. Must be unique per submitter and consistent across related records.

sample_label.description: Short lab label for the sample used on tubes and sheets.

project_code.description: Short machine-readable identifier for the research project this sample belongs to.

project_title.description: Human-readable name of the project under which sequencing was organized.

parent_project.description: Identifier of an overarching parent project that groups related sub-projects.

institution_name.description: Institution that has custody of the samples or data.

institution_ror.description: Persistent identifier for the institution (for example a ROR ID).

collected_by.description: Name of the person or people who collected the sample.

collector_orcid.description: ORCID or other persistent ID for the collector.

contact_email.description: Email contact for questions about this dataset.

collection_date.description: Calendar date when the environmental sample was collected from the field.

collection_datetime.description: Date and time of sampling in ISO 8601 format including timezone when known.

collection_time_local.description: Local clock time of sampling before conversion to a full ISO timestamp.

site_latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

site_longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

verbatim_lat.description: Latitude as originally recorded before conversion to decimal degrees.

verbatim_lon.description: Longitude as originally recorded before conversion to decimal degrees.

location_name.value: USA: Atlantic Ocean, east of Florida
location_name.description: Geographic origin written as country or sea name followed by region and locality.

water_body.description: Name of the water body where sampling occurred.

country.description: Country or sea associated with the sampling location.

habitat.description: Local-scale environment or habitat entities near the sample that influence it.

broad_biome.description: Broad-scale environmental context or biome of the sampling site.

sample_material.description: Environmental medium or material the sample is made of (water, soil, sediment, etc.).

natural_or_artificial_site.description: Whether the habitat is natural (0) or artificial (1).

sample_depth_m.description: Depth below the surface where the sample was taken, in meters.

min_depth_m.description: Minimum depth of the sampling interval in meters.

max_depth_m.description: Maximum depth of the sampling interval in meters.

bottom_depth_m.description: Total depth of the water column or seafloor depth at the station in meters.

elevation_m.description: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level in meters, if applicable.

water_temperature_C.description: In-situ temperature of the sample or water at the moment of sampling, degrees Celsius.

temp.description: Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling in degree Celsius

salinity.description: Practical salinity of the water sample in PSU.

ph.description: pH of the water or environmental sample at collection.

dissolved_oxygen.description: Dissolved oxygen concentration measured at sampling.

dissolved_oxygen_unit.description: Unit for the dissolved oxygen measurement.

turbidity.description: Turbidity of the water sample at collection.

chlorophyll.description: Chlorophyll concentration associated with the sample.

collection_method.description: Method or protocol used to collect the environmental sample.

collection_gear.description: Device or tool used to collect the environmental sample.

volume_collected_L.description: Amount of original environmental sample collected (volume). Unit given separately.

volume_collected_unit.description: Unit for the collected sample size or volume.

filter_pore_um.description: Pore size of the filter used during sample filtration, in micrometers.

prefilter_pore_um.description: Pore size of any prefilter used before the main filtration, micrometers.

filter_material.description: Material the filter membrane is made of.

filter_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the filter used, in millimeters.

pump_flow_rate.description: Flow rate of the pump used during active filtration.

filtration_notes.description: Additional notes on how the sample material was processed or filtered before extraction.

storage_freezer_C.description: Temperature at which the environmental sample was stored before DNA extraction, Celsius.

storage_duration.description: How long the sample was stored before processing (ISO 8601 duration when possible).

storage_location.description: Physical location where the sample was stored.

storage_solution.description: Buffer or preservative solution the sample was stored in, if any.

biological_replicate.description: Label distinguishing biological replicate samples from the same site or event.

extraction_date.description: Date when nucleic acids were extracted from the sample.

extraction_volume_ml.description: Volume or mass of sample material used for DNA extraction.

extraction_volume_unit.description: Unit for the amount of material used in DNA extraction.

extraction_kit.description: Commercial kit used for nucleic acid extraction.

extraction_protocol.description: Link or citation for the nucleic acid extraction method.

dna_concentration_method.description: Method used to measure nucleic acid concentration.

absorbance_260_280.description: Ratio of absorbance at 260 nm to 280 nm for DNA purity.

target_gene.description: Gene or genomic region targeted by the assay or primers.

target_subfragment.description: Subfragment or variable region of the target gene amplified.

forward_primer_seq.description: Nucleotide sequence of the forward PCR primer.

reverse_primer_seq.description: Nucleotide sequence of the reverse PCR primer.

forward_primer_name.description: Name of the forward PCR primer.

reverse_primer_name.description: Name of the reverse PCR primer.

amplicon_length_bp.description: Expected length of the PCR amplicon in base pairs.

annealing_temp_C.description: PCR annealing temperature in degrees Celsius.

pcr_cycles.description: Number of PCR cycles used for amplification.

pcr_reaction_volume_uL.description: Total volume of the PCR amplification reaction in microliters.

pcr_replicate.description: Integer identifying a PCR technical replicate within a sample.

thermocycler_model.description: Model of thermocycler used for PCR.

master_mix.description: Commercial master mix used for PCR.

sequencing_platform.description: Sequencing platform used to generate reads.

library_id.description: Identifier of a sequencing library (amplicon of a sample with unique indexes/MIDs).

library_layout.description: Whether sequencing libraries are single-end or paired-end.

forward_fastq.description: Filename of the forward sequencing reads.

reverse_fastq.description: Filename of the reverse sequencing reads.

assay_type.description: Whether the study uses a targeted assay (e.g. qPCR) or community metabarcoding.

license.description: License under which the data are shared.

notes_field.value: Slight chop; bottle rinsed twice before fill.
notes_field.description: Free-text remarks about the sampling event or sample.

lab_internal_batch.description: Internal lab batch label for DNA extraction runs. Not intended as a public standard term.

neg_control_flag.description: Whether this record is a negative control sample (1) or not (0).

pos_control_flag.description: Whether this record is a positive control sample (1) or not (0).
